title: fix round 1 for T-1679: test_spawn missing-CLI test must patch the new resolver, not shutil.which
spec:
Fix round 1 for T-1679 (gate red, one failure). Work in the existing worktree
/Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-1679 on branch task/T-1679; add one commit on top, keep the existing commits.

Failure (log wt/T-1679/.orchestrator/runs/tests/T-1679-20261006-225335.log):
  FAIL: test_run_claude_holds_when_cli_missing (tests/test_spawn.py, RunClaudeHoldsWhenCliMissing)
  AssertionError: Popen must not be called when the claude CLI is missing
Cause: the test simulates a missing CLI by patching shutil.which; the new resolver (orchestrator/claude_cli.py) now
falls back to fixed paths such as /opt/homebrew/bin/claude, which exist on this machine, so spawn finds a CLI and calls
Popen. The behaviour change is intended (that was the root cause of the 2026-10-06 stall).

Fix: make the test simulate "no CLI anywhere" through the resolver: patch orchestrator.claude_cli.resolve (or the
module's candidate list) to return None, keep the assertion that Popen is not called, and assert the hold reason now
reads "claude CLI not found; looked in: ..." as specified. Do not weaken the resolver. Check tests/test_spawn.py for
other tests that patch shutil.which to mean "missing CLI" and update them the same way.

The gate log also prints `RuntimeError: boom` in a traceback; it is not a failing test (it appears in other runs too).
Leave it.

Run in the foreground: uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_spawn.py tests/test_watchdog.py. Commit on task/T-1679.
acceptance: the missing-CLI test patches orchestrator.claude_cli and asserts the new hold reason

result.summary:
I made the fix and committed it, but the acceptance tests are not confirmed green: the unittest run ended with `FAILED (errors=2)`, and I don't have the error details.

**Summary**
- `test_run_claude_holds_when_cli_missing` now simulates "no CLI anywhere" by patching `orchestrator.claude_cli.resolve` to return `None`, instead of patching `shutil.which`.
- It still asserts that Popen is never called and that the run is logged as `no_cli`.
- It now asserts the hold reason equals `claude_cli.missing_reason()` and starts with `claude CLI not found; looked in: PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin/claude`.
- No other tests in `tests/test_spawn.py` patch `shutil.which` to mean a missing CLI. The four other patches (lines 38, 63, 2175, 2300) return `"claude"`, meaning the CLI is present, so I left them alone.
- I committed on `task/T-1682` in the current worktree (`a8a5909`), not on `task/T-1679` as the packet says. The harness told me to work here, and this branch already contains the T-1679 commits (its head was `f78a8d8`, the same as `task/T-1679`). If the merge expects the fix on `task/T-1679`, it needs a cherry-pick of `a8a5909`.

**Files changed**
- `tests/test_spawn.py`

**Test output**
- Run 1: `uv run python -m pytest ...` failed with `No module named pytest` (the repo uses unittest).
- Run 2: `uv run python -m unittest test_spawn test_watchdog`, run from `tests/`:
  ```
  Ran 168 tests in 22.435s
  FAILED (errors=2)
  ```
  I cut the output to the last lines, so the two errors weren't captured. I didn't run again because of the two-run limit. I can't tell whether they come from my change, from running inside `tests/` instead of the repo root, or from something already broken; the external gate will show the details.
- `scripts/failures_only.sh` doesn't exist in this worktree, so I couldn't produce its output.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
